service.description: Load a Moqui entity-facade-xml data file through the standard EntityDataLoader inside a running runtime. This is a runtime-safe fallback when offline Gradle load tasks are temporarily blocked by local temp/journal locks.

actions.script: Set effectiveDataTypes = (dataTypes ?: 'seed-initial,seed,install,demo').toString() .split(',') .collect { it?.trim() } .findAll { it } as Set def edl = ec.entity.makeDataLoader() .dataTypes(effectiveDataTypes) .dummyFks(dummyFks) .useTryInsert(useTryInsert) .disableEntityEca(disableEntityEca) .disableAuditLog(disableAuditLog) .disableFkCreate(disableFkCreate) .disableDataFeed(disableDataFeed) .transactionTimeout(transactionTimeout) edl.location(location) recordsLoaded = edl.load() ec.cache.getCache("entity.sequence.bank")?.clear()
